_doc: STAGING. Church rebuilt vocabulary-first against the bench-signed vocabulary, at their bar (one `named` row plus one `said`) and their one-moment test. The vocabulary they reviewed had the best `named` tier of any non-music list and one hole they called a dignity finding: NO HOMEGOING REGISTER. No repast, wake, eulogy, casket, nurse — the Black church's most-attended service is a funeral and the word list did not know it existed. Two boards here are that service, written plainly and without spectacle. EXTENDED with the fish fry, which yielded ONE board on its own and is a church fundraiser run by the same deacons in the same basement.

theme.name: Sunday Service
theme.blurb: The organ, the fan, the mothers in white, and the Friday fish fry that pays for the roof.

boards.scene: When the organ modulates and the room stands

clues.aspire: What the whole hour is pointed at, and it is not the sermon
clues.praise: Breaks out where the program says the offering should be, and the program loses
clues.rise: Nobody announces it. The Hammond drops a step and the room is already up
clues.reap: The half of the verse everyone can finish, and the reason it gets quoted
clues.ears: What the drummer is playing by, because the key changed without warning
clues.pair: Of white gloves, folded on a lap, belonging to a woman who has not moved

clues.giants: The verse is about facing them, and this choir sings it like they have
clues.saint: What the program calls the ones who go first, and the front pew is theirs
clues.sing: The instruction and the whole job, and the director mouths every word
clues.sang: Past tense, and the way it is said afterwards makes it a verdict
clues.gain: What the offering is not for, said twice, by a man who means it
clues.gnat: Circling the flowers at the front all through the second verse

boards.scene: The nurses' board, in white, along the wall

clues.insure: Not what they do. What they do has no policy behind it and no invoice
clues.nurse: White dress, white shoes, standing before anyone else notices anything
clues.rise: What she helps someone do afterwards, with a hand under the elbow
clues.rein: What she puts on the moment, so it stays the person's own
clues.ruin: What a fall on that floor would be, which is why she is standing there
clues.runs: For the fan, the water, the tissue, the whole hour, and sits down last

clues.humane: The word for feeding people on the worst day of their lives
clues.amen: Said quietly here, by fewer people, and it lands heavier than upstairs
clues.hum: What the room does instead of talking, for the first twenty minutes
clues.ham: On the long table with the foil pans, because somebody cooked all night
clues.hen: In the other pan, and the two of them are the whole menu, every time
clues.human: What the day makes everyone here, more plainly than any other day

clues.bowers: What the room does when he finally comes through the door
clues.robe: Zipped by somebody else, because he is already somewhere in the third point
clues.rose: In the lapel, from the box the flower committee brings without being asked
clues.sow: What the text is about, and the reaping is not until the fourth point
clues.brow: Wiped once before he goes out, and about forty times after
clues.bore: What he is privately afraid of being, which is why the notes are that long

boards.scene: Finding a seat when you have come in late

clues.powers: The verse says they are made perfect in weakness, which helps at this moment
clues.pew: Third from the back, and everyone in it slides without being asked
clues.rose: The one on the end, which means somebody is being remembered today
clues.sow: What the sermon is already ten minutes into, and you have missed the setup
clues.pose: What you strike coming down the aisle, and it fools absolutely nobody
clues.owe: The feeling walking in at half past, and it is entirely self-issued

clues.mouths: Some open, some moving without sound, and both count
clues.shout: Not a volume. A step, and the ushers know it before it starts
clues.hum: Under everything, from women who have known this hymn sixty years
clues.host: What the small table at the front holds, on the first Sunday
clues.moth: Circling the light above the choir stand, all through the invitation
clues.must: What she says about coming next week, to a visitor, holding both her hands

boards.scene: The man on the Hammond, who never once looks up

clues.organs: Plural because the building has two, and only one of them gets played
clues.organ: The Hammond, the Leslie spinning behind it, and the drawbars set his way
clues.song: He can carry it from a single hummed note, in any key, without asking
clues.sang: What the soloist did, and he was already under her before the second line
clues.gran: In the second row, who has been requesting the same hymn since 1981
clues.oars: What the whole room is pulling on by the last verse, together and slightly late

boards.scene: The window over the baptismal pool

clues.angels: In the glass, and the light through them lands on the water at eleven
clues.angel: Singular, in the pane nearest the door, with a hand raised
clues.sang: What the congregation did while somebody came up out of that water
clues.angle: The sun's, in October, which is the one Sunday it reaches the back wall
clues.gale: What the fan does in July, and it is not enough, and nobody complains
clues.lens: What the child in the third row has, and the photograph is terrible and kept

boards.scene: The plate sale, Friday, in the fellowship hall

clues.aliens: What the line out front looks like to the new pastor, and he learns fast
clues.sale: Plate. Ten dollars, cash, and the flyer went up on Tuesday
clues.aisle: Cleared of chairs by four so the tables can go where the pews are not
clues.line: Out the door by five, and it is mostly people from the block, not the church
clues.lane: Behind the building, where the cars idle with their hazards on
clues.seal: On the foil, pressed down hard, because these are going in car boots

boards.scene: Who cooks, and who is not allowed near the fryer

clues.boxers: What the two deacons on the fryer have been, about this, since 1998
clues.box: Styrofoam, hinged, and the count of them is the count of the evening
clues.robe: Hanging in the back, untouched, because tonight is not that kind of night
clues.rose: The price did, by a dollar, and it was announced from the pulpit
clues.bore: What the wait never is, because the line is where the news gets exchanged
clues.rob: What the price increase was called, loudly, by one man, every year

boards.scene: The slaw, and the recipe nobody will hand over

clues.bylaws: What the kitchen runs on, unwritten, and violating them is noticed
clues.slaw: Made Thursday night so it is right by Friday, and never bought
clues.sway: What the room does when somebody puts the radio on in the kitchen
clues.bays: The three sinks, and which one is for what is not negotiable
clues.slay: What the fish does to the fryer oil by the third batch
clues.lays: How the fish goes in: away from you, one at a time, never dropped
